policy: PROTOCOL.md ten-path curation keeps positive primary-metric paths in descending order. pear/xml_parser passed every gate (pinned release, documented local API, both valid controls equal to its raw-name expat oracle, container control, Xdebug package lines and stable parser-derived AFL++ feedback, labelled as a libxml2-family SAX wrapper) but ranks eleventh by Packagist total downloads after querypath/querypath, laminas/laminas-xml, simplesamlphp/xml-common and imangazaliev/didom were verified from the same 2026-11-17 snapshot. As for the Python JSON ceiling (data/python/json/ceiling-displaced.json), the audits require every project directory to be a selected catalog row, so its project and AFL++ overlay directories, verify script, pilot test and generated guide were removed; its full catalog row, verification record, AFL++ report row and feedback receipts are kept here. The removed files are at the base commit below.

overlay_receipt.feedback_scope: libxml2 2.15.4 parser.c (push parser), parserInternals.c and SAX2.c plus PHP 8.5.12 ext/xml/xml.c and ext/xml/compat.c (XMLParser API, xml_set_object and handler dispatch, expat-compatible SAX callbacks) via AFL++ allowlist; libxml2 tree, XPath and dict code, ext/libxml/libxml.c, the Zend engine and the interpreted XML_Parser and PEAR code are uninstrumented
overlay_receipt.fuzz_target: projects/xml/php/pear_xml_parser/fuzz-target.php (XML_Parser setInputString and parse with the summary handler object, no JSON output)
overlay_receipt.harness: projects/xml/php/pear_xml_parser/harness.php parsarium_parse (XML_Parser setInputString, setHandlerObj and parse, then JSON output)
overlay_receipt.baseline: fuzzing/afl-native/xml/php/pear_xml_parser/baseline.php (same handler object bound to a bare xml_parser_create/xml_parse, no XML_Parser or PEAR code)
overlay_receipt.shared_family: libxml2 push parser via PHP ext/xml (compat.c), shared with the standard xml_parser_create_ns/xml_parse path and the other libxml2 package paths

catalog_row.name: pear/xml_parser
catalog_row.license_evidence: https://github.com/pear/XML_Parser/blob/0134baa2df2054afcca41e9307b98a21db84365d/XML/Parser.php (BSD-2-Clause header; composer.json and composer.lock license ["BSD-2-Clause"] for 0134baa2df2054afcca41e9307b98a21db84365d)
catalog_row.input_api: new XML_Parser(), setHandlerObj(handler), setInputString(string) then parse() (documented in the PEAR manual 'Choosing input'); setInputFile(path) and setInput(resource) are cross-checked for the same summary
catalog_row.parser_family: libxml2 push parser via PHP ext/xml (xml_parser_create/xml_parse through ext/xml/compat.c); shared with the standard xml_parser_create_ns/xml_parse path and the other libxml2 package paths
catalog_row.package_own_scope: Object-oriented SAX driver over ext/xml: XML_Parser creates the parser (xml_parser_create, no namespace separator), sets case folding and target encoding, binds the handler object's startHandler/endHandler/cdataHandler/piHandler and other expat-style handlers (event mode) or derives xmltag_* methods (func mode), feeds the string in one final xml_parse call or a file/stream in 4096-byte fread chunks, frees the parser and wraps failures as PEAR XML_Parser_Error. Tokenizing, well-formedness, entity, character-reference and CDATA decoding are libxml2; event dispatch to PHP is ext/xml.
catalog_row.oracle: projects/xml/php/pear_xml_parser/oracle.py (Python expat without namespace processing: raw qualified names, every attribute including xmlns declarations in document order, trimmed text runs between element boundaries and processing instructions, processing instructions as target data)
catalog_row.family: libxml2 push parser via PHP ext/xml (xml_parser_create/xml_parse through ext/xml/compat.c); shared with the standard xml_parser_create_ns/xml_parse path and the other libxml2 package paths

popularity.caveat: Cumulative package downloads are a package adoption proxy, not XML parse counts. Packagist marks pear/xml_parser abandoned (no replacement suggested); v1.3.8 is from 2019-04-10, and many installs come as a dependency of other PEAR packages. It shares the libxml2 parser family, and ext/xml specifically, with the standard xml_parser_create_ns/xml_parse path.

caveats: Raw-name scope: XML_Parser has no namespace mode (xml_parser_create without a separator), so names are raw qualified names (prefix:local), no namespace URI is resolved, and xmlns/xmlns:* declarations, including <plain xmlns=""> in order-default-ns.xml, arrive as ordinary attributes. The summary does not infer URIs.
XML_Parser's default $folding = true upper-cases element and attribute names; the harness sets the documented public property to false.

Character data and CDATA share cdataHandler; text runs are trimmed and empty runs dropped. Comments and the XML declaration are not reported because XML_Parser has no comment handler and the harness defines no defaultHandler.

PHP 8.5.12 reports E_DEPRECATED for XML_Parser's xml_set_object(), string handler names (xml_set_element_handler, xml_set_character_data_handler, xml_set_processing_instruction_handler) and xml_parser_free(). The parse is unchanged; the notices are recorded in the feedback receipt. A future PHP that removes xml_set_object() would break this release.

The package's own PHP lines (Xdebug) are the same on both controls, because ext/xml dispatches every event from C. Its role is driving the parse: it creates and configures the ext/xml parser, binds handlers and feeds the bytes; the format-dependent behavior is libxml2 and ext/xml.

AFL++ feedback comes from a native overlay that runs the same harness on PHP 8.5.12 and libxml2 2.15.4 with only libxml2 parser.c, parserInternals.c, SAX2.c and PHP ext/xml/xml.c and compat.c instrumented. Because the interpreted package adds no tuples, the overlay compares a bare xml_parser_create/xml_parse baseline with the same handlers; see the feedback receipt. Only valid controls were run; no malformed, vulnerability or resource inputs.
